standard_prerequisites.name: The regular-model situation, the divided special fibre and the residue field of a component
standard_prerequisites.statement: The situation fixes a discrete valuation ring, a smooth projective curve over its fraction field, a regular proper model and the components of the special fibre with their multiplicities; dividing the special fibre by the greatest common divisor of the multiplicities yields an effective Cartier divisor, and its multiples are again effective Cartier divisors on the model. The special fibre is connected, each of its components is proper and geometrically reduced over the residue field, and the global sections of a proper geometrically reduced scheme over a field form a field extension; a line bundle on a proper curve whose restriction to each component is trivial is trivial. The author's own lemmas of the chapter and the quoted results of the Algebra, Divisors and Varieties chapters are the allowed inputs.
standard_prerequisites.use: The counted lemma is the technical heart of the section: it produces the chain of thickenings of the special fibre that the following lemmas use to compute cohomology, and the earlier card on the first cohomology of the reduction points at it.

core_obligations: Build the chain of subschemes: the multiples of the divided special fibre give a chain of effective Cartier divisors inside the model, and restricting to the special fibre produces the chain of subschemes displayed in the statement, starting from the reduction of the fibre (source lines 4829-4840).

Identify the intermediate members with the fibre of the corresponding multiple: each member of the chain is the inverse image of the preceding one, and the divisors are principal multiples of the divided fibre, which is what allows the successive quotients to be read off from the exact sequence comparing a divisor with its summand (source lines 4840-4850).

Compute the global sections: the reduction of the fibre is proper and geometrically reduced over the residue field, so its global sections are a field extension of the residue field, and the inclusion of the field extension identifies them with the residue field itself; the same computation then applies to every member of the chain (source lines 4850-4862).

Package the result: the chain and the identification of the fields are exactly the assertions of the statement, including the description of the successive quotients, which completes the proof (source lines 4862-4865).

proof_roadmap.step: Construct the chain of subschemes from the multiples of the divided special fibre.
Identify each member with the fibre of the corresponding multiple and write down the successive quotients.
Compute the global sections of the reduction and propagate the computation along the chain.
Collect the assertions of the statement.
